messages:
evan_sales: FYI — Bluestone sent an RFI. They need embedding throughput and latency estimates, licensing for curated weights if run in customer VPC, and a recommended POC plan. Target: 2M embeddings/day, p95 < 120ms for 1536-d vectors. Can we confirm feasibility and provide a short write-up they can include in the RFI?

sara_pm: I added the RFI packet to the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/bluestone/rfi (internal). I'll create a 'POC & perf' tab.

deploy-bot: File uploaded: bluestone_rfi_packet.zip (uploaded by sara_pm) :package:

alex_se: TL;DR: 120ms p95 is achievable but depends on deployment and batching. Hosted at scale needs Reserved/Dedicated to guarantee. Quick recommendation: Dedicated 2x A100, autoscale to 4, batch target 32, KV prefix cache enabled.

miguel_ml: Lab numbers: embed-curated-v2 (1536) on a100-80gb — p95 ~85ms at batch=32, p95 ~140ms at batch=8 under high concurrency. Cost estimate hosted optimized: ~$0.0008/embedding; Dedicated reduces unit cost with commit. If Bluestone can accept 1024-d vectors, expect ~25% lower latency and cost.

jordan_security: Compliance notes for RFI: SOC2 Type II report available for hosted; Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed KMS (HSM option as enterprise add-on); VPC peering supported for data residency; audit logs available on Dedicated with configurable retention. Hosted inference logs are ephemeral unless customer opts in.

ev an_sales: @alex_se @miguel_ml can you paste a short config snippet and a 2-row capability matrix (hosted vs dedicated vs private) we can include? Also need a one-paragraph licensing statement about redistributable rights for curated weights in Private.

alex_se: POC infra snippet below — copy into RFI: ```
# recommended dedicated pool
dedicated_pool:
  instance_type: a100-80gb
  replicas: 2
  autoscale_max: 4
  batch_target: 32
  kv_cache: enabled
  quantization_profile: q4_0
```

alex_se: Licensing blurb: "For enterprise Private deployments we provide redistributable rights for Redwood-curated model variants under our Enterprise Agreement; third-party model weights must be accompanied by customer-supplied licensing evidence."

miguel_ml: I'll attach a tiny benchmark table for the RFI showing p95 for dims 1024/1536 across batch sizes 1/16/32. Note: continuous batching reduces cost but can increase p95 under spiky patterns.

jordan_security: Bluestone also asked about IP protection and log retention. Clarify in RFI: Hosted — ephemeral debug logs, data retention policy available; Dedicated — full audit logs, configurable retention (90/365 days); Private — retention controlled by customer. We'll include exact policy excerpts.

ev an_sales: Great. Sara, can you assemble capability matrix + 3-week POC timeline? I'll send the RFI responses tomorrow AM.

sara_pm: On it. Draft plan: Week0 prep (setup creds + data sample), Week1 smoke perf, Week2 tuning + stability, Week3 evaluation + deliverables. Kickoff Wed 10am PT. Calendar invite sent to @alex_se @miguel_ml (mandatory), @jordan_security optional.

alex_se: Uploading the draft RFI answers and perf matrix now.
deploy-bot: File uploaded: bluestone_rfi_answers_v1.pdf (uploaded by alex_se) :white_check_mark:

miguel_ml: Added benchmark numbers to the drive and noted trade-offs for dim reductions.
jordan_security: Pasted canned compliance bullets into the doc. Legal to review licensing sentence before we send to customer.
ev an_sales: Thanks team. Action items: legal review of license blurb, sara finalize matrix, miguel finalize benchmark table, jordan include SOC2/retention snippets. I'll send once legal signs off. :thumbsup:
